title: Daughters of Zelophehad
english: On [[Zelophehad’s daughters and Moses’ successor >> Bible:Numbers 27]]: five daughters, their father dead without a son, appeal to Moses for a share of inheritance.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC (Numbers).
